content.text:
The contact page is fixed. The cause was the new support email address, `[EMAIL]`. It's one long string with no spaces, so the browser couldn't wrap it:

- **On desktop**, it ran past the right edge of the "Other ways to reach us" box.
- **On phones and tablets**, it was worse. It pushed the layout wider than the screen, so the whole page scrolled sideways and the right edge of the form fields was cut off.

I added a small rule to `site/css/pages.css` that lets the text in that contact-details box wrap when it doesn't fit. I didn't change any page content.

**Checks:**
- I rendered the page at 1280px, 800px and 375px wide before and after the fix. Before, it was too wide at 800px and 375px, and the email ran outside its box at all three sizes. After, nothing goes past the screen or box edges at any of them.
- On a phone, the email now wraps onto two lines inside its box (it breaks inside "acmestorefront").
- All 16 functional tests pass.

There's only one commit in the git history, so I couldn't check which part of yesterday's update caused this. The long email is the only thing that breaks the layout. If you'd rather it never split mid-word, the other option is a shorter address. I haven't committed the change.

STATUS: DONE
